NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots still aren't precise before/after pairs**

New: The description now has a "Relationship to prior work" section comparing this PR to #33086, and the author says they added a test for the whitespace case after `](`. Missing: The screenshots are still unpaired, with four "before" images and two "after" images and no captions. They don't show the same scenario before and after.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have laurynmm, who gave the feedback, follow up on the screenshots.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for adding the comparison with #33086. The screenshots still need work: please show each scenario as a matched before/after pair (for example in a table, with a short caption saying what is being tested), following the [guide on precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
